## Project

- [Download & install](https://SamyRai.github.io/go-z-ai/download.html): prebuilt signed binaries (macOS/Linux) or `go install`
- [Source code (go-z-ai)](https://github.com/SamyRai/go-z-ai): the Go source, issues, and releases
- [Changelog](https://SamyRai.github.io/go-z-ai/CHANGELOG.html): released changes by version
- [Contributing](https://SamyRai.github.io/go-z-ai/CONTRIBUTING.html): how to build, test, and submit changes
